# Will Cook's websites

This host's root page lists Will Cook's websites and films. Each website is its own project with its own source and its own agent entry where one exists.

- [Plectis Mathematics](https://wcook04.github.io/practical-formal-verification/map/): AI-assisted research on eight Erdős problems, with papers, records of failed approaches and Lean 4 proofs of partial results. Seven original questions remain open. The #1041 formal-statement counterexample is due to ani. The papers are not peer reviewed. Agent entry: https://wcook04.github.io/practical-formal-verification/llms.txt
- [Lean Exposition](https://wcook04.github.io/lean-exposition-site/): Three explanations of OpenAI’s full-support theorem for the Sherrington–Kirkpatrick spin glass, linked to Lean declarations and an argument map. The theorem and Lean proof are OpenAI’s. I made the explanations and links with AI; no mathematician has reviewed them.
- [Proof Reader](https://wcook04.github.io/proof-reader/): Read Contextual Embeddings (PLDI 2026) beside its authors’ Lean proof, with statement-to-code links and a graph of proof dependencies. Paper and proof by Frohlich, Foster, Kavvos and Wang. I made the reader and links with AI; the authors have not reviewed the links.
- [Quartic Reader](https://wcook04.github.io/quartic-query-lean/): Lean 4 formalisation of OpenAI’s nearly quartic randomized–quantum query-complexity separation, with mathematical expositions and a paragraph-linked proof reader. Original theorem by OpenAI; formalisation and explanations made with AI. No human has reviewed whether the Lean statements match the paper.
- [Plectis Atlas](https://wcook04.github.io/plectis-atlas/): An index of OpenAI’s mathematics manuscripts, Lean statement files and published assessments, grouped into 372 paper families. Reports credited to MathVet, Carlos Toledo’s cert-machine and Neal McBurnett. I assembled the index and statement links with AI. Agent entry: https://wcook04.github.io/plectis-atlas/llms.txt
- [Practical Formal Verification](https://wcook04.github.io/practical-formal-verification/explorer/): Dafny proofs for 16 selected computations in an 88-component research-workflow prototype, with generated Python and proof-coverage maps. The proofs cover those computations, not the complete system. Agent entry: https://wcook04.github.io/practical-formal-verification/llms.txt
- [Zenith](https://wcook04.github.io/plectis-zenith/): Experiments on whether records of earlier mistakes help language models test and repair code. A held-out study found 77.0% versus 69.2% fault-class detection. One model on 58 HumanEval problems; about half the gain came from timeouts. Study available in an unmerged branch. [Held-out study (unmerged revision)](https://github.com/wcook04/plectis-zenith/blob/def1d26160c840397c00b247b2f74266f97a4cee/docs/studies/kept-experience/README.md). [Study pull request #13](https://github.com/wcook04/plectis-zenith/pull/13). Agent entry: https://wcook04.github.io/plectis-zenith/llms.txt
- [Code Ontology Bridge](https://wcook04.github.io/code-ontology-bridge/): Exports Python code structure to DuckDB, with semantic descriptions and recursive SQL views for NVIDIA Auto Ontology’s text-to-SQL agent. Independent of NVIDIA. Descriptions helped DeepSeek in a 48-question direct-prompt study; no clear improvement in the 12-question Auto Ontology study.

Films, with their YouTube addresses and the website each belongs to, are listed in https://wcook04.github.io/sites.json.
Use each site's own source links and stated limits when describing its findings.
